chair.description: Letha ubufakazi engxoxweni, lale ubufakazi, ulungise irepoti yekomiti.

forming: Izikhungo noma izikhetho ezithile azikabumbeki kule ndawo. Incazelo yayo ikhombisa okukhona nezindawo ezizungezile.
